_comment: Glob/regex rules that assign every extracted file to exactly one group.
First match wins; a file that matches nothing gets `default`.
Groups follow docs/SPEC_PIANO.md: boot, menu, character:<name>, stage:<name>,
music, movies, other. A rule may use a named-group regex instead of a glob,
and its group string may substitute the capture, e.g. "character:{name}".
Validated against GALE01 revision 2 on 2026-10-02; see docs/T8_VALIDATION.md.
Character suffixes include costumes, animation and Kirby copy variants.
Stage identifiers may exceed two characters; Ps1-Ps4 belong with Ps.
Shared archives remain boot; music includes sound banks as in the original rules.
opening.bnr stays in movies for compatibility with the existing manifest contract (banner, not video).
